title: UK deploys warship in the Mediterranean to protect British bases in Cyprus
summary: A British warship is on its way to Cyprus. More than a week ago, a British Royal Air Force base was hit by an Iranian-made drone. The opposition criticizes the UK's Prime Minister Keir Starmer for taking too long to send reinforcements. The country's ministry of Defence defended its actions saying the Royal Navy worked hard to complete six weeks' of work in…
